Create a research guide project from a DGF

create_rg.Rd

Scaffolds a research-guide Quarto document (full data profile) pointed at a DGF, plus a starter `DG.R`, ready to customize and render.

Usage

create_rg(
  dgf = "DGF.xlsx",
  data = NULL,
  dir = ".",
  file = "research-guide.qmd",
  embed_css = FALSE,
  render = FALSE,
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

dgf

Path to a DGF `.xlsx` file, or a DGF data frame (which is written to `DGF.xlsx` in `dir`). Defaults to `"DGF.xlsx"`.

data

Optional path to the raw dataset. Defaults to `NULL`. The report renders from the DGF alone, so this is only needed when a custom chunk or `DG.R` wants the underlying values; when supplied it is read into `raw.data` in the document.

dir

Directory to scaffold into. Defaults to the current directory.

file

Name for the report document. Defaults to `"research-guide.qmd"`.

embed_css

Logical; write the stylesheet into the document instead of calling [datagoodr_css()] at render. Defaults to `FALSE`. Use it to edit the CSS in place, accepting that an embedded copy stops tracking the packaged stylesheet.

render

Logical; render the document immediately. Defaults to `FALSE` (scaffold only, so the user can annotate it first).

overwrite

Logical; overwrite an existing document. Defaults to `FALSE`.

Value

Invisibly, the path to the scaffolded (or rendered) document.

Details

The DGF path is baked into the document's YAML, so it renders on its own from RStudio/Positron. To re-render against a different DGF later, use [update_rg()] rather than re-scaffolding: it overrides at render time and leaves your edits to the document intact.

See also

[create_dd()], [update_rg()], [use_datagoodr_template()]
